Water and meal quantities follow part 1. Lodging supplies a real qualifying stay, not automatic rest rewards. A map update takes one active desk hour using actual relevant records; it adds their true facts, not secured terrain or firsthand mapping marks. An escort needs its actual team, journey, food and availability, not a free additional army. Preservation charges once per begun 10 lb of the accepted nonempty bill. The provider supplies compatible real inputs and the exact method/lot limits: use 30 minutes per lot and the 24-hour treatment where that is the governing method. Payment cannot preserve an unsupported active core. Ordinary repair service takes the actual qualifications and at least max(1 hour, maximum HP/10 hours); special Broken magic bodies retain their specific requirements. An inclusive service price replaces the self-repair material bill. ### FL-25 — Coins, unlawful operations, labor and rescue Track each coin's denomination, composition, count/weight, custody and actual mint acceptance. Declare the assay method and suspected defect before the roll; do not make a generic and specific test for the same uncertainty or switch to the easier one after failure. | Generic bulk assay | DC | |---|---:| | Obvious defect | 10 | | Mixed/clipped coin | 13 | | Plated/adulterated coin | 16 | | Expert false mint | 19 | | Specific Core method/defect | DC | Preserved value range | |---|---:|---| | Trace shaving, 1–3% | 12 | 95–99% face | | Light shaving, 4–8% | 14 | 85–95% face | | Heavy shaving, 9–15% | 16 | 70–85% face | | Ruined shaving, 16–30%, once weighed | 10 | 40–70% face | | Washed/plated, without cutting or magic | 18 | 5–25% recoverable value | One ordinary assay work unit handles up to 100 coins or 10 lb, whichever limit is reached first, in 30 active minutes. Keep materially different variants identified. Use INT (Investigation) or the relevant actual proficient tool once. An applicable functioning jeweler's-scale, touchstone, milled-edge or merchant-test-kit method can supply its source proficiency contribution to that assay, not a second proficiency bonus, general training or supernatural detection. Destructive testing spends the actual sample. Routine documented weighing needs no new roll. Failure leaves uncertainty. Only a declared false-assessment stake can give a fallible critical-failure report; no die changes metal. New evidence or a genuinely different test can justify more work and another roll. Changing the appraiser alone cannot. KEEP ordinary assay fees at 1% of the face value of the actual accepted assay bill, minimum 1 gp for that real service, and remint fees at 2% of the recovered legitimate metal value accepted for actual reminting. A combined commissioned assay bill receives its minimum once, not per coin, variant or thirty-minute stage; services not incurred create no fee, and an already-owned private testing toolkit creates no fictional desk fee to its owner. KEEP the Loop greater-of rule for a holder lawfully established to be knowing, not a 10% cap. NEW explicit total-payment and fee allocation: let F be the confirmed false lot's face value, A the actual assay fee, R the actual remint fee, and S=A+R for the same assessed lot/bill; the total monetary liability is P=max(0.10×F,S), allocated to service fees S and an additional criminal fine of P−S=max(0,0.10×F−S). Do not charge P plus those fees or levy another 10% fine on top. Compute on exact amounts under FL-21/EC-10's existing final-transaction copper rounding; allocating the total between fees and fine does not itself create extra transactions. Credit actual prior payments and fees already withheld from returned legitimate metal once against the same liability, leaving only its unpaid balance. Confirmed counterfeit coin or plated false currency is seized in full only through actual lawful authority; seizure is neither a fee nor a payment credit. Genuine coins and legitimate metal remain separately identified and are returned with actual fee deductions accounted for once. An innocent holder with documented provenance pays no criminal fine; absent a lawful knowing-holder finding, this rule imposes no criminal fine. Suspicion, ancestry, a failed die or missing documentation alone does not establish knowledge. Assessment, collection and custody require actual authorized actors; an unpaid amount remains an obligation, not automatic borrowing or remote confiscation. Cutting/reminting takes the provider's actual work and links consumed/replaced coin identities to real metal/output quantities without duplication. Unlawful trade still needs real contacts, agreed terms, actual cargo movement, any real concealment/document act and actual payment. Resolve only stages that exist as separate uncertainties. A deal does not create forged authority, a new skill or a free Scribing recipe. Underways Heat is 0–6 for the actual operation/institution pursuit history. A triggering act adds its highest applicable category once: petty illicit 1, restricted 2, strategic theft/smuggling 3, trafficking/forbidden 4. At each completed 24-hour Haven interval with an active operation, roll once; d6 at or below Heat triggers the declared enforcement complication. Heat 0 has none. Faction reporting does not add a second roll. An actual accepted bribe of 10% of the agreed lot value reduces Heat by 1, or 25% by 2, spending the payment once. An active operation's Heat cannot fall below 1; no bribe is paid at 0. Refusal or unsuccessful negotiation grants no reduction. Renaming/repacking an operation does not reset evidence, Heat or unresolved legal consequences. Enforcement requires actual actors, authority and means, not remote automatic seizure. People remain actors with factual and asserted legal status recorded separately: Free, Contracted, Debt-Bound, Penal, Enslaved, Rescued/Liberated or Disputed. A label creates no ownership, restraint or immunity. Use actual body weight, equipment and reviewed casualty Load: Tiny 1.5, Small 3, Medium 6, Large 12; larger unsupported bodies require their profile. Petrification multiplies body pounds by 10, not casualty Load. All melded and external passenger equipment burdens an outside carrier. Voluntary passengers use their actual seats/custody facts, not captive ownership. Ordinary lawful wages are 1 gp/day unskilled, 3 gp skilled or 10 gp specialist; dangerous expedition work doubles them unless the named service or real contract supplies its own rate. Do not charge both. A wage day buys at most two eight-hour work Watches and a protected Rest opportunity. Extra risky/emergency duty requires actual agreement and its costs/Rest Debt. A lawful debt bond records principal, credited wages and agreed simple interest no greater than 10% per literal Opening; no hidden compounding or automatic debt. Coercion, kidnapping, fraud or unlawful confinement cannot demand an invented buyout. An actual trafficking investigation uses an Evidence Clock 0–4. A concrete accessible lead takes one active hour and the appropriate Investigation/relevant-skill task at declared DC/stakes. Success adds 1, Critical Success 2, capped at 4; repeated evidence adds nothing. At 4, seek a real authorized warrant/hearing or plan a genuine rescue/raid. The clock does not conjure police, prove a false report or resolve combat. Guards, restraints and escape routes are actual scene facts. Consent-based adult services remain distinct from trafficking, with the table's boundaries controlling. ### FL-26 — Advancement and the next descent Choose milestone or optional XP advancement before awards. Do not grant both for the same achievement. The milestone default grants an earned stated level when its actual objective is confirmed, not simply after a Watch, appraisal or return. Follow the real class, ASI, Arch and Hero schedule and pending acquisition constraints. A higher maximum does not heal or refill a pool; retain spent resources and grant only the actually earned new unspent Hit Die. For optional XP, freeze each eligible recipient's actual gap to their next level at the beginning of the distinct award scene: | Achievement | Percentage of that frozen gap | |---|---:| | Routine | 5% | | Standard | 10% | | Hard | 15% | | Severe | 25% | | Guardian victory | 40% | | Actual profitable extraction meeting its declared threshold | 10% | | First qualifying route/text/faction discovery | 5–15%, chosen before resolution | Sum that scene's eligible predeclared percentages, cap at 60% of the frozen gap, then round the scene award once to the nearest 10 XP, halves upward. If rounding exceeds the exact 60% ceiling, limit the award to floor(0.60 × gap ÷ 10) × 10. Do not recalculate earlier percentages against a larger new gap after a mid-scene level. At a level cap or without a supplied next threshold, invent no next gap or XP award. All materially contributing members can qualify, including real reconnaissance, research, transport and support contributions away from the fight. Roster presence, unrelated waiting, repeated reports or reused evidence are not automatic contributions. Name the actual contribution, unique achievement and eligible recipient. Notifications, sale, claim or auction records of the same achievement do not award it again. Crafting-domain XP stays its own ledger. A valuable failed objective can have a predeclared reward; do not invent one after failure. Close the episode at its actual time with outcomes and the declared success metric, each member's location, routes/camps, Pressure, pursuit/Heat, provisions and containers, HP/Wounds/injuries/Strain/Rest Debt/resources, companions/devices/corpses, cargo title/custody and terminal harvest/salvage claims. Include quotes, actual payments, liabilities, insurance, attributable standing/renown, pending faction actions and earned advancement. Then accept the next charter prospectively, with real access, budget, reserves and abort conditions. A new descent does not erase unresolved disputes, replenish stock, reset clocks or replay an old claim. It can proceed only when its actual conditions allow it. ## 4. Social scenes and faction work ### SO-01 — Ask for a concrete outcome State what your character wants and how they try to obtain it. You can describe the approach in ordinary words; you do not need to perform a voice, accent or persuasive speech. Before a consequential check, establish this scene frame: | Field | What to establish | |---|---| | Want | The specific change each side wants before the scene ends | | Leverage | The offer, evidence, threat or withholding each side can actually use | | Limit | What the decision-maker cannot or will not concede under current conditions | | Clock | The real deadline and time needed for this exchange | | Witness | Who can perceive the exchange or later receive a report | Identify the people involved, the resource or information requested, its owner/controller, and who can authorize the concession. A person may possess a key without permission to sell the building. A clerk may permit supervised viewing without permission to give away the record. The Director states the obtainable success and its terms, failure, any optional costly alternative, any available extra on Critical Success, and any extra consequence on Critical Failure. Agree the approach, ability/skill, resolution method, difficulty, duration and costs before committing the work and rolling. The Director can preserve secrets while explaining an observable obstacle or that this request cannot currently succeed. A promised ordinary Success cannot secretly require Critical Success or acquire a new price after the die. If willingness, authority and prerequisites already settle a routine request, record the agreement and carry it out without a check. If the requested outcome is impossible or presently unavailable, no check can create it. You may seek a different feasible outcome. Roll when a meaningful, possible uncertainty remains. Close the approach when its agreement, refusal or interruption is recorded. Later performance can still be pending. A new request follows the changed-circumstances rules below. ### SO-02 — Resolve the declared uncertainty Choose the procedure before seeing any dice. A social concession or bounded inference normally uses a task against a fixed DC. Two actors making genuinely opposed attempts can use opposed totals. An explicit feature using a saving throw or passive Insight keeps its own procedure. These are new ordinary references where no more specific source supplies the DC: | DC | Negotiable concession | |---:|---| | 10 | Plausible, modest and within the person's authority | | 13 | The person has a substantial reservation | | 16 | Difficult, but genuinely negotiable | | 19 | Exceptional leverage for an actually possible outcome | Do not add a general route-tier or standing modifier to these DCs. Use only adjustments an applicable rule actually grants. For a fixed task, compare the total with the DC: at least DC+10 is Critical Success; at least DC is Success; at most DC−10 is Critical Failure; the remaining totals below DC are Failure. Then a natural 20 improves one degree and a natural 1 worsens one, bounded at the ends. An impossible action does not acquire a roll or a fabricated failure margin. | Final degree | Result | |---|---| | Critical Success | The promised success on its stated terms, plus only the declared available extra | | Success | The promised success on its stated terms | | Failure | The declared refusal/failure; a costly alternative exists only if offered beforehand and feasible | | Critical Failure | That failure plus only the declared actual extra consequence; a costly alternative exists only if expressly offered for this branch | An optional costly agreement is separate from the failed check. Accept its stated terms if willing and able, or decline and keep the unspent payment along with the refusal. Accepting needs no new roll merely to enact a feasible offer. Its performance still takes time, and the original roll remains failed. No outcome degree automatically supplies obedience, truth, standing, consent or resources. For opposed checks, compare the two declared final totals: higher wins; a tie leaves the existing situation unchanged. Task degree shifts for natural 1/20 do not apply, and there is no general opposed critical reward. Ordinary saves remain binary under Core. Apply an operative source's reroll only in its exact window and with its exact replacement rule. ### SO-03 — Choose a skill for the approach | Skill | What the approach can resolve | |---|---| | CHA (Persuasion) | A genuinely negotiable decision on stated terms | | CHA (Deception) | Belief in a particular communicated claim | | CHA (Intimidation) | A decision influenced by a credible perceived risk | | CHA (Performance) | The declared audience response to an actual performance | | CHA (Reputation) | An appeal to credentials or standing actually known or credibly demonstrated to the recipient | | WIS (Insight) | A supported inference about observed motive, hesitation or leverage | | INT (Investigation), History or an appropriate tool/skill | Its actual evidence or knowledge task, such as examining a document | Add one applicable proficiency contribution, or expertise replacing it where granted. Several persuasive proficiencies do not add several bonuses. Neither a numeric trade level nor the saved standing score adds another bonus unless a specific operative rule says so. Deception can change a belief without changing history. Insight cannot read an inaccessible document, detect every lie, read minds or force a player to believe a diagnosis. A sound answer can be that the observed evidence cannot distinguish two motives. Translation establishes received meaning, not truth. A particular lie confronted by active scrutiny can use CHA (Deception) opposed by WIS (Insight). A bounded inference without an active opponent normally uses a fixed DC. Physical forgery examination uses its declared Investigation/tool procedure. A credible threat does not automatically require a saving throw or impose Frightened. A genuine competing social strategy can be an opposed attempt when declared that way beforehand. Useful true information may settle a routine request without rolling. A successful Performance grants its stated audience response, not a license, access to property or magical crowd control. A Reputation appeal must have evidence the recipient can actually receive. The result does not automatically change permanent standing. ### SO-04 — Use standing as a relationship This chapter uses the new ordinary standing scale taught in the Haven module: | Score | Band | |---:|---| | −3 or −2 | Hated | | −1 | Disliked | | 0 | Neutral | | +1 | Liked | | +2 or +3 | Honored | Standing can influence whether an institution will consider a request and what terms are plausible. It does not itself create permission, credit, an appointment, available stock or authority. It adds no automatic bonus, penalty, advantage or disadvantage to a social check under this procedure. CHA (Reputation) remains a separate skill: add its one eligible proficiency/expertise contribution to an appropriate appeal. A known score of +2 does not add another +2. Specific acquired item, class and background modifiers retain their actual conditions and stacking rules. Reviewed equipment sale fractions still use the buyer's known relationship where that particular schedule applies; they are not a universal price modifier. When bringing forward an older character, preserve the original score and its version. A companion record marked +2 and an older Loop record marked +2 did not use the same labels. Unknown versions need interpretation before use; absence is not a recorded neutral score. Keep genuinely earned access, titles and obligations even when deriving a new display. ### SO-05 — Keep alignment-dependent questions separate Ordinary social checks in this candidate receive no automatic alignment-derived advantage or disadvantage. Shared goals, stated values, promises and trustworthy conduct can provide genuine leverage in the scene; they do not establish a cosmic classification or add a numerical modifier. An acquired oath or class feature still follows its exact stated restrictions. If a particular use depends on a deep meaning not yet defined, record that specific unresolved requirement. It does not prevent ordinary conversation, trade, travel or a standing record. The older alignment-modifier wording is preserved for the later cosmology review. This chapter does not establish its compatibility chart or activate that general modifier. ### SO-06 — Keep one clock and a working channel Everyone participates on the same fictional clock. A ten-minute negotiation involving four people normally advances ten minutes, provided their actual exchanges fit that time. A person's contribution can occupy that interval without adding another ten minutes to the world. Declare these new ordinary time references before work: | Exchange | Actual time | |---|---| | Short request and answer | 1 minute | | Negotiated concession or evidence presentation | 10 minutes | | Formal complex negotiation/hearing | Its scheduled time; an ordinary disputed Haven hearing is 2 hours | Simple routine consent can be immediate within real brief communication. These references do not replace a printed Action, casting time, five-exchange limit or other specific procedure. Add time for actual extra exchanges or delays, not for how quickly a player speaks at the table. In initiative, each creature has at most six seconds of aggregate free ordinary speech/signs per numbered round. Replies, warnings and extra turns share it. Each additional six-second segment requires an available Action on a legal turn or an actual off-turn permission. Communication does not create an interruption, Reaction or additional Action. Use the fulfilled language rules for ten-minute rehearsal of up to six simple cues and each cue's actual hands, sight and distance. An interpreter first receives a comprehensible message, then conveys it through a channel the next person can receive. A three-second warning followed by a three-second rendition arrives at the second listener at six seconds. A ten-minute original speech plus its rendition needs time for both; relays do not happen instantly. Late information cannot backdate a decision, modifier, consent or saving-throw requirement. An interpreter does not supply a caster's verbal component, new fluency, a mental link, the meaning of an unknown proper name or proof the message is true. Use each participant's actual language, mode and script knowledge. A closed soundproof compartment cannot receive an oral instruction through a high check. Deafened does not itself prevent speaking or verbal components. Silenced prevents ordinary deliberate speech and actual verbal components, Chants and command words, while separately legal signs, thoughts or mental effects retain their own rules. An effect ending does not remove another overlapping prohibition. Form-specific limits and exact Oracle/Paladin exceptions remain in force. Player explanations and accessibility accommodations cost no fictional Action and produce no fictional speech or component. ### SO-07 — Help with the work; retry when something changes In initiative, Help uses its actual Action and expires at the helper's next regular start. The contribution must be possible with the helper's real position, channel, tools and information. Social play does not extend the expiry to a convenient later check. The attack-assistance branch still requires a foe within 5 feet and benefits the helped ally's first attack before that deadline. Outside initiative, this new procedure grants advantage on one check when a helper participates usefully throughout the relevant work interval through its resolution. The helper needs the actual language, access, knowledge or tools their contribution requires. There is no new universal proficiency requirement where ordinary Help has none. Mere presence, payment or ownership of a better tool is not Help. A helper's time is occupied. They cannot also guard a different room, rest, travel elsewhere or fully help a simultaneous separate negotiation. If an exact long task defines its own trained assistants and numeric cap, use that procedure without adding this general Help benefit. Multiple sources of advantage do not stack; any advantage and any disadvantage cancel to a normal roll under Core. Resolve one committed approach to the same uncertainty once. Rotating speakers, repeating the sentence or renaming the scene does not grant more attempts. A new offer, authentic new evidence, an audience with different real authority, a changed deadline or a meaningfully different method can create a new uncertainty. Identify that change and declare the new stakes, time and costs before rolling. Earlier refusal, spent time, payments, consumed evidence and other consequences remain. A source-granted reroll follows its exact cost, timing and new-result rule; it is not permission for unlimited retries. ### SO-08 — Apply the exact magical effect Charmed is a relationship to an identified charmer. It prevents choices the affected creature knows would willingly harm that charmer and gives that charmer advantage on social ability checks against it. It does not compel affection, obedience, belief, allegiance, surrender, protection, self-harm, consent, ownership or truthful speech. Unexpected collateral harm is not retroactively a willing violation. Frightened gives disadvantage on checks and attacks while the creature can see its fear source. Forced movement is not willing approach. Successful ordinary Intimidation grants only its declared concession and does not automatically apply this condition. Use the complete procedure of an effect the character has legitimately acquired and can currently use. A title or a familiar spell name does not grant an unavailable effect or merge ordinary, class, innate and recipe versions. Knowledge features reveal only information supported by their exact source and subject. Unknown remains possible. They do not establish ownership, invent a buyer or route, supply an absent cure or resolve deferred cosmology. ### SO-09 — Record agreements and respect table choices Record an agreement's actual parties and authority, property or service, deliverable, consideration, time, communication, witnesses and remedies. A clerk's promise of supervised access is not a transfer of the employer's ledger. A guard's key does not authorize selling the absent owner's property. Later breach is a new event; it does not change the earlier die result. The Session Zero agreement governs player consent and table boundaries. A skill check cannot assign a player's belief, require acting, override agreed PvP limits or grant their willingness to an effect that requires it. A player can pause, skip or request an accessible way to participate without explaining personal circumstances or receiving a character penalty. Failure alone does not deduct the payment. An unavailable object, absent person or forged receipt cannot provide missing performance. Establish each relevant permission when that operation needs it. A later agreement cannot retroactively supply a missing action prerequisite or turn counterfeit provenance into genuine evidence. ### SO-10 — Let consequences reach the people who react Standing changes follow significant attributable acts and a real way for the institution to learn about them. Record what happened, who acted, witnesses or documents, what each recipient actually learned, and when. A privately rescued person's relationship may change before any institution hears the story. Public means exposed or documented to a relevant audience; it does not mean every faction instantly knows. One deed reported five times remains one underlying cause for that institution. Different institutions can react differently when their interests and information actually differ. Separate established facts from reports and beliefs. An institution can act on a lie it believes; that belief does not rewrite the historical event. A later correction creates a new evidence/response record, not silent erasure or an automatic equal-and-opposite score change. For ordinary standing, start from the subject's score at the opening of that institution/scene record. Sum the signed proposed changes from distinct eligible events, limit that sum to −2 through +2, then apply the −3 through +3 scale. Keep proposed change, applied change and any overflow. Overflow is historical information, not future credit. Recompute from the scene opening as additional events arrive; do not saturate each event separately and lose an offsetting change. A successful social check does not automatically award standing, renown or a license. A genuinely performed, attributable public outcome can support the declared event. Existing titles, access, obligations and privileges remain separate records with their own terms. Delayed notice cannot backdate permission to an earlier purchase. ### SO-11 — Faction activity takes real work Other groups act on the campaign clock using the people, resources and information they actually possess. Their work can continue while your expedition is away. After a genuine expedition return, the Director reviews up to three watched factions and one eligible action for each. A return closes a real episode with an objective and outcome, including abandonment or extraction. Repeatedly crossing the boundary during the same return does not create more activity. A split party's arrivals stay linked to their actual episode. The new regular review also occurs at each completed campaign 24-hour boundary. A return at exactly the same time and that scheduled review form one checkpoint. A checkpoint records and reports work; it does not itself advance the world by 24 hours or give free labor, goods, recruits or success. | Action | Actual ordinary work when no more specific procedure applies | |---|---| | Recruit | 8 active staff hours seeking/interviewing one available candidate | | Denounce | 1 active hour preparing/delivering one attributable statement to an actual audience | | Buy | 1 active hour arranging/executing an available bill with real goods, funds and authority | | Raid | Actual preparation, route, encounter and resolution | | Research | The particular research process; a generic original-evidence question requires 8 active hours and its declared knowledge task | | Fortify | Actual construction under the camp procedure | | Bargain | 1 active hour of concrete negotiation | | Conceal | 8 active hours working on finite evidence, an asset or a route | | Wait | The actual interval and status, with no automatic money, healing or knowledge | Specific procedures keep their actual duration and costs, even when shorter. Do not add a second free faction outcome to them. An ongoing project keeps its identity and accumulated work. A return cannot replace it with an instantly completed action. When real work finishes between checkpoints, its consequences occur then. A later report acknowledges them once. People who witness the result can react immediately without waiting for the administrative review. News still needs a real messenger, rumor, changed offer, guard presence or other observable event to reach you. ### SO-12 — Rival objectives leave a history Rival groups have bounded goals, strengths, weaknesses and information. They travel real routes, need support, and can offer useful cooperation as well as opposition. Their successes can change the situation without erasing your expedition's choices. The Director tracks four kinds of objective clock: | Clock | Length fixed when opened | Qualifying progress | |---|---:|---| | Depth | 4–8 | Actual travel or support that materially advances its named route objective | | Claim | 4 | Genuinely obtained relevant proof, witnesses or legal support | | Grudge | 4 | Attributable humiliation, loss, betrayal or public accusation actually learned by the rival | | Collapse | 4–6 | Actual casualty, debt, internal conflict or exposure materially advancing the named crisis | One distinct qualifying event advances that clock by one segment. Several labels for the same deed or repeated reports do not add segments. A knowledge-dependent trigger qualifies when the rival first credibly receives it, not when an unknown event happens elsewhere. One event can affect different clocks only through independently real consequences. The Director declares the finite completion consequence and its prerequisites when opening the clock. Reaching its threshold resolves it once only when those prerequisites exist. Otherwise it remains at its threshold with the specific missing requirement recorded. A clock does not teleport travelers, authenticate a false witness, create title or grant an extra attack. An objective already actually completed needs no meaningless extra ticks. A resolved objective keeps its event history; a new clock needs a distinct objective or crisis. A genuine reversal is another recorded event, not erasure or an automatic refund. Players learn only the rival identity, events and consequences their characters can actually know. ## 5. Mounts, vehicles and transport ### TR-01 — Choose an actual mount Use the complete [transport catalogue](TRANSPORT_CATALOGUE_CANDIDATE.md) for Camel, Donkey or mule, Elephant, Draft horse, Riding horse, War horse, Mastiff, Pony and Warhound. These profiles supply no class levels, RP, spellcasting, special immunity or class features. Its separate harness draw rating is not extra back capacity. No repair, stable fee, new template or replacement purchase revives a dead individual. ### TR-02 — Control and training A physically compatible, trained and willing mount can be controlled. An intelligent or untrained independent mount keeps its own agency. Ownership, restraint and payment do not establish willingness or training. A conscious, nonincapacitated seated rider can direct intended movement and choose the controlled mount's one allowed Action: **Dash, Disengage or Dodge**. Use an actual trained audible or tactile channel. An audible cue shares the language rules' speech allowance. Reins require an available hand; a trained seat/leg cue works only if that individual knows it and the current seat permits it. Ordinary riding direction adds no separate Bonus Action. It does not issue a class companion command, authorize an attack or transfer rider bonuses to the animal. A source-bound companion with only an attached phase retains its own command and offensive budgets; calling it a mount does not give it a full turn. Additional pack animals can be led outside combat through real handling, but do not give a third controlled combat turn. There is no automatic animal swarm. An independent NPC acting as a party character counts toward the twelve-character roster. A merely ridden animal does not occupy a member seat, although its actions, cargo, provisions and history still matter. Independent animals are directed by their real agency, not treated as free player attack orders. Recheck control when the mount acts. If the rider is no longer seated or able to cue it, the channel fails, or the mount is unable or unwilling, an unexecuted riding cue cannot compel it. If able, it defensively Dodges and stays still or moves only to an immediately safer available space, chosen through its actual agency. Its existing turn and spent budgets do not reset. An executed cue is not undone. A legitimate trained noncombat lead/follow cue can continue only while its actual conditions and handler remain available. **New ordinary training course.** A genuinely tame, willing animal can learn one named riding or harness function through 40 active hours, at most four credited training hours per animal per day. The instructor needs Animal Handling proficiency, a suitable safe space, fitting tack and a usable conditioning method. Credit complete 15-minute phases. An interruption loses unfinished prospective phase credit; actual time, feed and fees remain spent. The full-course tuition reference is 5 gp, unless an actual voluntary or paid agreement differs. Completion requires the real course and demonstrated safe routine behavior. It grants only the practiced function, without an obedience spell, rider proficiency or Ranger bond. A documented already-trained animal needs no repeat course. Wildness or unwillingness cannot be cured by depositing hours. A war-named purchase includes combat habituation only if its actual contract and behavior establish it. Feed, water, tack and stabling are separate unless genuinely included. ### TR-03 — One complete mount turn At initiative registration, a controlled mount shares its rider's initiative value and takes one complete regular turn immediately **after** the rider's complete regular turn. Their movement and Actions do not interleave. You cannot move the mount twenty feet, insert a free rider attack segment, then finish the mount's movement. You may Ready a permitted Action through the normal procedure, paying your Action and later Reaction, with its actual trigger, components and duration. This creates no free attack. An independent mount keeps its own initiative and choices. The mount has its own regular-start/end markers, movement, normal Action and applicable Reaction budget. Its controlled Actions remain Dash, Disengage and Dodge. Control grants no offensive Reaction or opportunity attack; a specific defensive Reaction works only if actually available. It makes its own death saves when its lifecycle requires them. A rider's extra turn does not create another mount turn, start, recharge or condition tick. Each physical actor receives at most one scheduled regular turn per numbered round. Mounting, dismounting or changing controllers retains its spent budgets and original allocated slot for that round. Changing to independent behavior also grants no second turn. Separate rider and mount effects still expire at their own stated markers even when initiative values match. ### TR-04 — Mounting, dismounting and losing the seat An ordinary mount or voluntary dismount costs half your current walking Speed, rounded down in feet, from your remaining regular movement. A positive Speed whose half is below one instead costs one foot. Speed 0 does not permit it. You may perform at most one mount **or** dismount operation per regular turn; an extra turn supplies no additional operation through this rule. The cost is movement, not a Bonus Action or free object interaction. Start within five feet of the accessible seat at a reachable height, with a stable approach, one usable supporting hand and a physically fitting destination. A high Elephant saddle needs actual steps, help or a legal route to reach it; an exotic saddle does not lift you. If Prone, first stand using the real cost or use another valid assisted procedure. Mounting does not remove Prone. To dismount, choose a visible, free adjacent space within five feet of the relevant body boundary at a reachable level. A wall, another creature, an inadequate gap or an unpaid fall is not a legal destination. Insufficient remaining movement or an inaccessible seat prevents the ordinary operation. A specific acquired feature overrides only its actual clause. The animal's remaining movement and Actions stay unchanged. When one resolved source event moves a seated rider's mount against its will **or** knocks it Prone, the rider makes one DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. If that same event does both, make one save. Resolve actual height and falling under the falling rules; unseating adds no fixed damage by itself. On success, retain the seat only if support remains physically possible. Impossible support or landing resolves through the real fall/entrapment situation, never placement inside a wall. ### TR-05 — Position, areas and opportunity attacks Record the rider's actual saddle point or fitting five-foot subspace on the mount before movement. Attacks, reach, line of effect and area exposure use that position, not every edge of an Elephant's footprint. Passive displacement of vehicle occupants gives no generic opportunity attack without a specific source. Moving pullers can provoke for themselves, without granting an attack through a wall against a distant passenger. ### TR-06 — Movement belongs to the actor who performs it Riding changes your position, but it does not automatically spend your movement, perform your leap, count as your flight or charge, deal your weapon damage or activate a class feature. Mounts, vehicles and transport ### TR-01 — Choose an actual mount Keep the individual's original body history through purchase, hire, boarding, rescue, bond and sale. A healthy profile does not prove that a merchant's specimen is healthy, willing, trained or available. Significance cannot be changed after a fatal outcome. The new threat reference level is solely for the expedition encounter-budget comparison. It is neither CR nor class level. An effect requiring a source CR still needs that actual missing predicate. Do not substitute threat reference, purchase value or carrying rating for a bond prerequisite or harvest table. The catalogue's Load and draw limits are separately authored. They do not follow an inferred Strength formula and cannot be increased by recalculating one. Apply later actual source exceptions only where they govern this same individual. ### TR-02 — Control and training Record the controlling relation, the trained function and cue, seated rider, available hand/channel, animal willingness, actor-cap usage and actual turn. Ordinary riding cues are rechecked at execution; this explicitly differs from a protected already-issued attached companion command that may survive owner incapacity. Do not import TI04 device binding, a shared companion Bonus Action or an attack allowance into ordinary riding. Carriage and ship control have the separately paid Actions below. Unattended lead/follow is not a programmable tactical routine or unlimited work. Training is an actual bounded course. Its maximum four hours/day applies to that animal, not a new cap per instructor or per course name. Forty hours means at least ten such training days. Safe completion grants no immunity to later fear, fatigue, pain, anatomy restrictions or changed conditions. ### TR-03 — One complete mount turn Record actor ID, numbered round, regular-turn ID, original slot, prospective next-round slot, control history, and movement/Action/Reaction spent. Keep condition and death-save ordering attached to the actual creature. Ordinary ridden turns are whole turns. The coordinated puller reservation for a drawn vehicle below is a specific exception for one linked vehicle movement, not permission to split every mount's turn. Travel and initiative transitions preserve real movement/work and do not duplicate ticks or rewards. ### TR-04 — Mounting, dismounting and losing the seat Predeclare the actual saddle point, approach and preferred dismount ordering where relevant. Record the triggering source event so one forced-and-Prone result does not create two saves. Do not infer another trigger from a renamed template or the rider's own Prone condition. Success is not immunity to falling when no supporting body remains. Keep actual seat compatibility and the control predicates separate from the save. Resolve height, falling, collision and support through their own real sources instead of inserting an automatic unseat-damage packet. ### TR-05 — Position, areas and opportunity attacks Keep the mount footprint, rider seat, actual movement path and each target's defenses. At a provoking edge, validate the chosen target before spending/rolling the reaction. Actual legal defensive reactions belong to the chosen target; no mount-and-rider pooled defense is created. The same movement cannot provoke twice merely because both rider and mount moved. Turning travel into initiative is not a movement event. A positional aura reads actual body locations even when carriage does not qualify for a self-powered movement benefit. ### TR-06 — Movement belongs to the actor who performs it Preserve the literal Dragoon protected interface and complete engine alongside this new interpretation; the old sentence did not explicitly say self-propelled. The fifteen-foot Momentum trigger and twenty-foot casting interaction are separate gates. A legal dismount, self-powered move/leap and personal attack can satisfy the actual engine, without counting the same path twice. Keep both complete pending feat records, their original flags and current full-review-pending status. Old needsReview:false is not proof of current review. No broad text match across 1,223 class cards establishes movement eligibility. Exact position, actor, turn, movement budget and activation predicates are required. Nothing here replaces closed companion commands, recipe devices, servicing, recycling, recharge or source-specific casting procedures. ### TR-07 — Tack, food, water and boarding All fourteen original tack/drawn-vehicle/service rows retain their full source records, including comma placeholders, null numerical weights and source status. New physical quantities are separate fields. A service is not a half-pound object; unknown weight is not zero. Record actual fitting, workers, hands, anatomy, item HP, stock, nutrition and custody. A caretaker cannot supervise incompatible remote pens at the same time. The ten-minute calm care allowance is not emergency veterinary treatment. Barding cost, mass, HP and worn AC use distinct rules. Apply the actual sized armor reference once for repair, not the animal's purchase value or HP. Fitted tack can be repaired from its actual primary body and compatible subordinate parts; neither repair nor a saddle creates a missing animal. ### TR-08 — Drawn vehicles and the two sleds Record the coordinated movement reservation as one exceptional vehicle event, not ordinary interleaved riding turns. Each puller needs a legal existing movement budget and actual control; the vehicle does not create free offensive caravan actors. One Action or movement contribution cannot pay a different task too. Cart, Wagon, Carriage, Chariot and Player Sled retain their complete catalogue dimensions, seats, primary structures and terrain. Do not equate a frame's HP with payload or use an invented five-times-Strength towing formula. An indivisible blocked bend remains a real route problem. A disabled frame strands its actual cargo until a feasible unload, transfer, support or tow occurs. HP 0 alone does not destroy occupants, contents or source history. Collision, dislodgement and falling are separate actual events with their declared consequences. ### TR-09 — Watercraft need working crews The full profiles preserve each exact active-mode Speed, mph, minimum depth, geometry, occupant count and original-body repair requirements. New operating values do not fill in or overwrite the old source blanks. “Warship” grants no ballista or separate combat-stat package. Track all paid crew contributions, current availability, the single numbered-round drive event and the actual resulting path. Passive passenger displacement is not personal movement expenditure, Dragoon Momentum or the mounted opportunity-attack exception. Passengers may do compatible tasks only when the actual environment permits; a moving ship is not automatically a full workshop or safe rest site. No vessel quote supplies a conveniently present rescue boat or crew. Plan escape from actual positions, remaining time, usable lines, boats, bodies and Actions. Real support can preserve a disabled wreck for repair; its contents and history remain real even if submerged. ### TR-10 — Porters, bearers and hired pack animals Keep service scope separate from anatomy and ownership. A contracted six Load may fit a mule's body but not its actual current burden or route. The rate purchases an agreed service interval, not feed or unlimited extra work unless the offer really includes it. Apply the service-specific price before the one accepted danger multiplier. Do not add the generic 1/3/10 gp wage schedule to the named porter/bearer rate or double once per danger adjective. Maintain actual paid/owed status without automatic borrowing. Calm loading uses the transfer schedule below. Dangerous travel uses the real route/encounter procedure, not another service roll that charges the same consequence twice. Actual workers' consent, refusal and information remain distinct from inert inventory. ### TR-11 — The bound hauler and specialist services The hauler is bound to the separate core.transport.hauler profile. The 500 gp quote and 20/30 Load references are historical; its mass, body, oil, maintenance, control and repair are explicitly new additions. Do not replace these with a class machine's rules because both are called a hauler. Track exact accumulated moving time, fuel fractions, refill/consumption events, service-due state and actual completed work. A partial service is not completed service, and one work interval cannot also restore HP or recharge another device. A damaged required mechanism must be made serviceable through its real repair before routine service can qualify. Caravan availability, a real slot and the actual specialist teleport are world inputs. Do not invent infinite capacity, a current spell, post-Opening access, planar permission or spatial-container capacity from a price. Preserve Living/Changed, Pact and deep-setting labels literally for the later review. ### TR-12 — People, stretchers and cargo transfers Keep distinct body, gear, containers and shares. Petrification changes only the body pounds and never turns six casualty Load into sixty. Reusing a transformed character's personal meld exemption on the outside carrier would omit real weight. The stretcher's patient admission and each carrier's total burden are independent checks. Its frame and every gear item still count. An unstable transfer can fail even when numerical limits fit; conversely no roll is needed to invent uncertainty in a genuinely safe supported lift. Preserve voluntary, unconscious, restrained and disputed-custody states separately. Unknown actual landing space or insufficient support is not repaired by a cargo tag. A dead body remains the same history-bearing body under its real lifecycle, not a fresh generic loot bundle. ### TR-13 — One route rate, with real transfers Keep route identity and fraction complete before changing the limiting rate. Record actual physical quality independently of Unknown/Sketched/Mapped/Secured mapping knowledge and Risk 1–5. Apply the 480-minute reference only once to the actual work tranche. Do not use a zero required-carrier speed as a division shortcut or silently omit that actor. Determine the real transfer, abandonment or repair first. Source-specific route/hazard rules override only their actual scope. For declared cargo loss, retain the original at-risk manifest, event, chosen eligible lots/portions and indivisibility remainder. Do not stack the Core illustration with a Loop consequence unless they are genuinely independent declared effects. Living/Changed and Pact Interdiction remain literal specialist/deep-setting receipts, without invented geography, causes or permissions. ### TR-14 — Recover living creatures; repair actual structures Distinguish living treatment, mundane structural repair, recipe-magical restoration, the new hauler bridge and one-time emergency shoring. Each uses its real eligibility and source. A payment is not evidence that a missing body, material, worker or worksite exists. For a damaged vessel, record damage-event ID, HP-0 time, original deadline, shoring eligibility, workers, uninterrupted interval, supplies, result, any sixty-minute hold deadline, actual support and evacuation. The hull does not regain movement from successful shoring. A failed or interrupted attempt cannot backdate completion beyond the old deadline. Track rescued actors and goods individually, with actual custody, remaining conditions and source history. Keep family admission, overload, control-loss, interrupted-movement, damage/HP-0, repair/rescue and provenance examples as authored expectations. They do not claim that live transport software or human balance has been tested. ### Worked chapter cases #### TRX-01 **Situation:** A willing animal completes the40-hour ordinary training course at its maximum4 credited hours/day. **Expected result:** At least10 training days are required; two instructors cannot create an8-hour animal training day. #### TRX-02 **Situation:** A rider acts, then its mount begins its whole turn and moves into a new reach. **Expected result:** The rider has no inserted free turn segment. # Advanced crafting — player candidate guide

**REVIEWED — authored operational PLAYTEST.** Use this guide with the Enchanting, Rune Carving, Scribing and Tinkering candidate cards and their body catalogue. Each card supplies its actual numbers, ingredients, formula access, station and work time. This guide supplies the common procedures. A recipe name, price or ingredient mention grants no unprinted power or automatic access to stock.

## Make one recorded work order

Choose the recipe and one permitted complete body model and size before starting. Reserve `floor(1.5 × printed quantity)` actual complete ordinary bodies in a fixed order. These bodies are additional to all printed process components and required working implements. They must never have been magically altered, must have positive HP and remain complete, and cannot simultaneously serve another order, a consumed ingredient or the working toolkit. An ordinary weapon or armor suit retains its genuinely established grade and permitted physical history. Fixed carriers use Standard grade. Automaton chassis must be unmodified, unflawed ordinary B5 chassis, with Tiny or Small chosen before work.

All maximum-yield reserves must still qualify immediately before the single completion roll, even if Standard would use fewer. Missing, Broken, incomplete or committed reserves pause work. Lawful pre-roll repair or replacement retains that entry's position and records its actual history. There is no post-roll substitution, purchase or choice of the best bodies. Transform the first resolved number of bodies; unused ones remain their actual mundane stock. Failed or Mishap transforms none, although a genuine mishap can damage stock. Returning unused bodies is not ingredient recovery.

The actual creator, station and safe storage must accommodate the work. Reserves can occupy separate lawful storage while each body is worked sequentially; they need not all fit on one bench. Source ingredients remain required for the whole printed batch, not once for each output. Their mass does not produce extra complete bodies or get added again to each output. Preserve physical identity, compatible containment, damage, losses and material age throughout.

## Training, access and work

All four trades are artisan creation using INT. Their primary credentials are Enchanter's tools, Runecarver's tools, Calligrapher's supplies and Tinker's tools respectively. Add one actually applicable PB, or replacing expertise, rather than adding numerical trade level. An untrained character can attempt an otherwise eligible level 1–4 recipe without tool PB and with disadvantage. Trained recipe eligibility is `max(4, trade level)`, with actual source/formula access. Recipes above level 4 still require the required formula. Possession of a finished item teaches neither its formula nor its trade.

Use the card's real station and auxiliary implements. A complete ordinary toolkit can supply the ordinary implements actually inside it; it does not also supply expensive tiered ingredients or a workstation. Source facilities and ordinary tools give no automatic bonus. An actually available compatible facility uses the established rental baseline of 1 gp per eight reserved hours. Paying that rate does not create capacity or permission.

These creation cards have `fieldCraftable=false`. A historical `timeMode=field` label does not waive that flag. An expedition worksite still needs the genuine fortified/research-site permission and fixed required facility. Other workshop, Haven and longer-term permissions retain their own requirements. Only eligible assistants within the card's limit can assist; they must work all required hours, do not shorten the order and receive no assistant crafting XP.

An actually eligible Forge Dwarf multiplies creation time by 0.75, rounding up once to a whole minute, and treats a Standard creation result as Exceptional. This changes neither access nor ingredients. It does not reduce repair, servicing, research, encoding, attunement, ordinary calendar waits or rest. Respect the two-active-work-Watch limit and actual rest restrictions; the same hours cannot also count as guard duty, travel, another job or beneficial rest.

The first stable phase is `min(15 minutes, adjusted total active creation time)` and is included in the printed total. Preregister later phases of at most eight active hours. Completed phases stabilize only the actual eligible incorporated inputs. Raw stock and a recoverable catalyst keep their own age and protection requirements. Interruption loses unfinished-phase progress, not costs, completed phases or physical history. Ineligible inputs pause the order; unfinished work has no active item power.

Use the existing crafting framework's first-success, repeat, qualified-failure and triviality rules. The card preserves its exact progression and capped trivial threshold. Using, repairing, servicing or studying an item does not award that recipe's creation XP. Formula research and ordinary formula copying keep their own reviewed procedures.

## Resolve the six creation outcomes

| Margin against the recipe DC | Outcome | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or more | Masterwork | `floor(1.5Q)` outputs, or Q with the structural option; at most one eligible catalyst unit retained |
| 5–9 | Exceptional | `floor(1.25Q)` outputs, or Q with the structural option |
| 0–4 | Standard | Q outputs |
| −1 to −4 | Flawed | `floor(Q/2)` when Q≥2; see singleton rules below |
| −5 to −9 | Failed | No output; bounded ingredient recovery |
| −10 or worse, or natural 1 | Mishap | No output; consumed materials lost and the actual tradeskill mishap procedure applies |

A natural 20 adds no extra manufacturing-band shift. The Forge Dwarf adjustment changes Standard to Exceptional only. Choose the permitted yield or structural option once for the batch. It never improves charges, damage, DC, spell rank, service count, research potency, carrying capacity or other magical properties.

For a structural object, the Exceptional/Masterwork alternative retains Q outputs with P25/P50 workmanship. Use its actual ordinary B after legitimate size and grade, and only the strongest existing or newly selected percentage. Maximum HP is `B + max(1, floor(B×P/100))` for positive P; otherwise B. Apply one persistent flaw last: `max(1, floor(improved maximum/2))`. Retain the old damage deficit, `old maximum − old current`, and subtract it from the new maximum, clamped to [0, new maximum]. Standard does not heal. At B5, unflawed maxima are 5/6/7; flawed maxima are 2/3/3. At B1 they are 1/2/2 and 1/1/1.

A structural Q1 Flawed result creates one persistently flawed item, which can finish Broken if retained damage reaches its reduced maximum. Q≥2 Flawed only reduces yield and retains actual prior flaws; producing one output from that batch does not add a singleton flaw. No extra duration penalty is invented for these durable carriers. Repair does not erase the flaw or repeat the workmanship increase.

Automata are the explicit creature exception. Their printed creature AC and HP never increase from structural quality. Choosing the alternative simply retains Q with a quality label and no mechanical improvement. Q1 Flawed maps to Failed, including that failure's recovery procedure. Q≥2 keeps the reduced yield. A produced automaton starts at `max(1, floor(printed creature HP × latest chassis current HP / 5))`; a full chassis produces full printed HP. This is a creation conversion, not level scaling or a second structural track.

## Inputs, retained tools and failure returns

Keep every component occurrence separate, including repeated catalog IDs. Its consumed flag and role govern what happens. An expensive object labeled tool can be a consumed process input; it cannot also be the retained working implement. A price, core/essence title or material description does not make it a catalyst.

Masterwork may retain at most one actual unit total from an eligible consumed catalyst occurrence on that recipe, chosen after the check. It must have participated nondestructively until retention is resolved. The returned unit retains identity, age, condition and compatible vessel; it is not also a second embedded core in an output.

On Failed creation, for each eligible exact consumed non-catalyst input identity, recover at most one quarter of its fixed consumed-input quantity for this batch, capped by the eligible amount actually remaining from those same inputs, and rounded down once to that identity's legal source-unit precision. Do not take one quarter of the surviving remainder. Previously returned, forfeited or lost quantities and unrelated stock cannot fund this recovery. For each exact eligible identity in this batch, use `recovered_i = u_i × floor(min(Q_i / 4, R_i) / u_i)`. Q_i is its fixed consumed-input quantity; R_i is the eligible amount surviving from those same inputs; u_i is its legal source-unit precision. Group only genuinely identical eligible inputs within this same batch while retaining every physical occurrence. Catalysts and unrelated batches do not enter that recovery group. The expressly divisible bulk profiles are Enchanting Veilthread; Rune Carving Runic ink and Binding agent; Scribing Ink and Preservation treatment. They use 0.01 of their exact source unit only when actually supplied in that divisible form. Other stones, lenses, matrices, glyph pieces, parchment/cover/binding units, hardware packs, cells and consumed tools are indivisible unless their own genuine independent profile permits subdivision. No quarter-lens, value conversion, remainder banking or second salvage pass over failed waste.

Mishap or abandonment returns no consumed inputs. Nonconsumed tools and unused reserved bodies remain only as they actually survive. Existing gathering, preservation, finite-matter and exclusive-debris histories still apply. A public ingredient mention does not disclose a donor dossier, grant acquisition rights, supply missing metadata or make the required stock free.

## Structure, state and repair

The body catalogue gives complete physical bodies, primary members, dimensions, hands and capacity. Structural AC protects the item, not its bearer. Ordinary equipment targeting, actual damage compatibility and carried-item protection still apply. One aggregate HP track does not give each screw, page or limb a second independently targetable pool. A name or a flag does not establish intact structure.

Magic requires an actual complete positive-HP, accessible, unmelded, unsuppressed participating item. Required hands, legal bearing positions and line of effect remain mandatory. completeCounterparts.name: Alignment Sanctuary

operational.targets: One fixed 10-foot-radius, 10-foot-high area centered on suitable approximately horizontal immobile ground or surface within range and line of effect. Your casting class selects Abjuration rank 3 or Shaman Conjuration rank 6; rank-6 Conjuration requires both of your canonical alignment axes explicitly recorded before casting.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. If cast in initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; preserve that virtual marker through order changes or departure. If cast outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if concentration ends.
operational.resolution: Snapshot the caster's actual canonical alignment at application; do not infer it from ancestry, faction, reputation, faith, appearance or conduct. Abjuration rank 3 uses Wisdom saves against your spell DC for opposed entrants. Conjuration rank 6 uses exact matching admission with no save. The snapshot is fixed for this application.
operational.effect: Abjuration rank 3: a creature is opposed if at least one explicitly known axis is exact opposite to the snapshot (Lawful/Chaotic or Good/Evil). Neutral is never opposite; an unknown axis supplies no opposition, and does not erase a known opposite on the other axis. On an opposed creature's attempted entry from outside, roll its Wisdom save before entry, including forced movement, carriage or teleportation. REVIEWED CADENCE CLARIFICATION: record that success or failure for this source character, mode and target until the target's next regular-start marker; the current in-progress start never counts. A success permits entries during that window; failure blocks all non-Falling entry attempts during it without repeat rolls. Same-caster replacement/recasting does not reset this window. Outside initiative, use a fixed 6-second window and preserve its deadline if initiative starts. A failed physical entry stops before the boundary; a failed teleport leaves the creature at its origin without refunding committed teleport costs. Conjuration rank 6: only a creature with both explicit canonical axes exactly matching both snapshotted axes may enter from outside. Unknown is not matching. Nonmatching physical entry, forced movement and carriage stop before entry; a teleport attempt to place a nonmatching creature inside leaves it at origin after costs are committed.
operational.scaling: None. Shaman's preserved Conjuration rank-6 access costs 13 RP before ordinary surcharges; extra RP or character level cannot select another placement.
operational.limitations: Both modes allow existing occupants to remain or leave; once outside, entry restrictions apply. Unsupported ordinary Falling is not arrested, supplies no platform and adds no movement; it can place a creature inside. No AC/save bonus, healing, rest guarantee, resource recovery, attack immunity, concealment, morality compulsion or alignment change. The ward denies entry rather than Actions and does not consume the shared hard-denial ledger. Multiple casters' wards retain independent source permissions and save windows; no single ward's success bypasses another ward. The preserved rank-6 Abjuration aligned-benefits placement has no actual class-access grant and stays unassigned/unavailable; its vague benefits are not imported. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, Abjuration rank-3 opposed-entry Wisdom save and Shaman Conjuration rank-6 same-alignment safe haven. NEW CONFLICT RULINGS: fixed 10-foot-radius/height and concentration 1 minute replace Instantaneous metadata; actual modes stay separate, unassigned rank-6 Abjuration benefits remain blocked. NEW: snapshots, entry/teleport/Falling handling and exact two-axis Conjuration matching. Save-window/recast and rank-6 snapshot-validity completions are jointly reviewed provisional rules.

currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
# Spell integration rules — provisional v0.1

Use this document with the [shared class rules](CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md), the class's own engine and the [spell packet](SPELL_PLAYTEST_STARTER.md). This is a staged development layer, not an approved-book replacement or a live companion update.

## What owns each decision

| Decision | Source used for this packet |
|---|---|
| Spell identity, every school placement and per-class rank/access | Preserved `src/data/spells.js`; do not collapse different class ranks into one global rank. |
| Common RP prices and additional spell evidence | Core Systems Known Descent V2. Its spell blocks are retained with the catalog summaries. |
| Class identity, engine, spellbook/preparation and cadence exceptions | The current class playtest packet. |
| Generic Dissonance/Refrain, action limits and core conditions | Shared class playtest rules; source Core conditions remain unchanged. |
| Missing targeting, exact endpoints, concentration ambiguities and exploit limits | Explicitly provisional decisions on each spell card. |

The approved Core V2 source has 936 spell blocks. The companion catalog has 848 unique IDs with 936 school placements, but leaves four metadata fields unspecified. These are different views of the source, not evidence that all casting details were absent. Core's generic “Automatic or opposed as described” does not supply a concrete save or targeting rule.

Eleven possible renamed entries remain comparative evidence in the register. Harmonic Bulwark's catalog summary says 5 temporary HP per RP while the possible historical Mana Shield entry says 2; its [individual transformation and buffer review](TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md) now supplies the operational decision. Both source variants remain preserved. Other unresolved aliases stay pending their own review; matching names never silently merge effects.

Resonance Kindle now has [exact manuscript approval](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_CONJURATION_CANTRIP_EXACT_REVIEW.md): Action/Self/V/S, recover 1 RP only when this spell reaches resolution. Its one character-wide use is spent at legal cast start and refreshes only on a beneficial completed long rest. The comparative Mana Kindle block remains separately preserved; its broader wording does not trigger recovery from other cantrips and its historical range grants no remote recipient. The [Conjuration cantrip status](CONJURATION_CANTRIP_REVIEW_STATUS.json) records this bounded decision and the other eleven approved cards.

## Select a spell

1. Choose the class through which you are learning/casting it. Check that class's school access and minimum **class** level on the card.
2. Use that class's spell rank and Core V2 cost. A different eligible class may receive the same spell at a different rank and level.
3. Record it in your allowed known, prepared or spellbook choices. An eligible catalog entry is not an automatic grant. Wizard and Druid keep their explicit preparation systems; fallback counts apply only where the class has no more specific rule.
4. Select only a spell marked `operational-playtest-draft` in this packet, or an operational spell expressly supplied by a class card. Other records stay visible in the unfinished queue.
5. A class card and an ordinary spell with the same name remain separate records with separate acquisition and costs. Knowing one does not grant the other. Oath spells, Matrix techniques and similar class spells use their own card.

Oracle uses RC and its Mystery/Curse system. Soldier and Warrior have no general Weave access. Dragoon first gains ordinary magic at class 3; Paladin at class 2. Sufficient RP, total character level, a class feature with the same name, or a borrowed spellbook cannot bypass a gate.

## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Commit the legal cast's RP, materials and other printed costs before any attack/save or interruption. Perform its components and establish concentration if required, ending incompatible prior concentration. An ordinary missed, saved-against or countered legal cast refunds nothing and never restores displaced concentration.
5. At this cast's beginning, apply ordinary Dissonance and Refrain once: 0 base for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9; consecutive same-named casts add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3. First cast or a different name adds +0. Apply the class's exact protected reduction, routing or vent and any hook whose printed trigger is beginning/casting. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous name/Refrain unless the class expressly says so. This chronological commitment occurs before the Counterspell window; a later Reaction cast updates its own history, and resuming the earlier cast does not update that history again.
6. Open legal cast-interruption Reactions, resolving nested counters last-in, first-out. A surviving cast then resolves its effect: spell attacks are d20 + PB + the actual casting ability modifier; save DC is 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the exact card's hit/failure/success results and ordinary damage/conditions. Outcome-dependent class hooks occur only at their printed timing and with the required actual result. No automatic cantrip scaling applies. A negated spell grants no success/hit/damage effect merely because its casting cost was paid.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot supply an ungranted Action, duplicate concentration or resource reset. A readied spell commits this casting sequence at preparation; release has no second cast, cost, cadence update or Counterspell window.

Countering requires an actual operational spell or class card, its repertoire/access and a legal remaining Reaction. The ordinary Counterspell is now reviewed; it is separate from the Mage and Wizard class cards. Dispel Minor, Dispel Resonance, Dispel Magic (Lesser) and Dispel Magic use their exact individual scopes. Rank-limited dispels inspect the original generating cast's spell rank, not RP cost or the dispeller's rank. Higher and unassigned source variants retain their own unfinished status.

## Counterspell checks and interruption

The [exact notebook review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_ABJURATION_RANK2_3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) confirms this authored timing interface and corrects the earlier binary-check proposal using the existing [Core roll rules](CORE_RESOLUTION_PLAYTEST.md). This is a tabletop procedure; the pricing helper does not implement nested reactions.

Ordinary Counterspell uses its casting class's actual spellcasting ability + PB against **DC 10 + twice the triggering spell's actual rank**. The class Wizard/Mage cards retain their printed Intelligence + PB check and their own acquisition, cost, rank and recharge. Apply the existing fixed-DC task degrees and natural shifts, then collapse Critical Success/Success to success and Failure/Critical Failure to failure. No extra critical counter effect is invented. It is neither a spell attack nor a saving throw.

| Natural d20 + modifier | DC | Existing task result | Counter result |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 20 + 0 | 22 | Failure improves to Success | Success |
| 1 + 9 | 10 | Success worsens to Failure | Failure |
| 1 + 20 | 10 | Critical Success worsens to Success | Success |

The target must be an actual pending spell with a recorded rank. The Director may use hidden source data without revealing the spell's identity/rank; attempting grants no free identification. An unassigned rank is not automatically zero. A source-defined technique is not counterable merely because it spends RP or resembles magic.

A creature normally attempts Counterspell once against a particular pending cast, across its ordinary and same-named class sources. Another Reaction alone does not supply another attempt. An exact source expressly granting an additional attempt against that same cast overrides the default. After failure, another eligible creature may react; after negation there is no further trigger. Counterspell is itself a spell and can be countered. Resolve nested counters last-in, first-out and resume surviving parents without recasting, paying again, or replaying their earlier Refrain/Dissonance. Negation refunds no costs and restores no prior concentration. Countering one spell is not whole-Action/turn hard denial and does not spend that combined ledger.

## Falling bridge — new provisional procedure

This is a newly authored table procedure agreed with the GPT notebook, **not recovered V6/Core V2 canon**. Focused searches of the current rulebook extract, Core V2 and mechanics/manual text found spell summaries but no operational falling clock or impact formula. Before promotion to canon, inspect the approved V6 environment/travel/hazard sections and archived environment tables. Preserve any older rule found and compare it explicitly.

When a creature loses support with no movement mode or effect keeping it aloft, it enters **Falling** immediately. Falling means unsupported; it grants no hovering, airborne walking or lateral movement. Track total distance descended during this fall and cumulative distance during its current uncontrolled portion, both initially zero.

**Timing:** If a fall begins during a regular initiative turn, set a fixed Fall Marker at the **end of that initiative slot in the following round**. Resolve the first Falling Step there, then one at the same marker each round. Reactions and extra turns use the enclosing regular initiative slot; an event between slots uses the most recently completed slot. Extra turns, extra Actions and initiative changes neither move nor multiply the marker. This gives every participant one normal turn opportunity before the first descent; inability to act still matters and no free rescue action is granted. A caster still needs legal targets within range when spending their Action.

Outside initiative, when timing matters, establish an order before descent and use a virtual slot immediately before its first regular slot as the initiating slot. The first step occurs when that virtual slot next recurs, after everyone has had one normal turn opportunity. When no rescue or other timing decision is possible, the Director can resolve the same descent and impact calculation directly. This is an explicit timing abstraction, not a model of physical acceleration.

If a fall begins after initiative has been established but before any regular initiative slot has yet completed, treat the virtual pre-round slot as the most recently completed slot for Fall Marker purposes.

**Ordinary descent:** At each step descend up to **300 feet**, stopping on a supporting surface. Add the distance to both trackers. On landing while uncontrolled, take **min(10, floor(uncontrolled distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning damage**. The uncontrolled distance includes earlier steps; never use only the final step's remainder.

**Feather Fall:** The spell retains its **Action** casting time and reduces descent to at most **60 feet per step**. When it takes effect, set uncontrolled distance to zero: the magic dissipates prior uncontrolled momentum in this abstraction. Keep total fall distance. If landing while it remains active, damage is **min(3, floor(total fall distance / 20))d6 bludgeoning**. This explicitly limits impact exposure without guaranteeing a harmless landing. When the spell ends aloft, reset uncontrolled distance to zero, then accumulate ordinary descent from that point at the existing marker; expiry grants no immediate extra step. Its one-minute maximum ends immediately before the caster's regular turn ten rounds after casting. If expiry and a step coincide, resolve expiry first. Earlier landing or cessation of Falling ends the spell on that target as printed.

Apply damage defenses only when their actual wording covers that damage. After damage, Falling ends; a creature suffering any positive falling damage lands **Prone** unless an explicit feature prevents it. Less than 20 relevant feet produces zero damage. Forced movement that removes support starts a fall but adds no separate fall damage. Regaining genuine support, secure support from a hold, or flight ends Falling without resolving an uncompleted impact; teleporting safely onto support likewise ends it. A later loss of support begins a new fall with new trackers and marker. Completed impact and damage cannot be undone by later casting.

| Scenario | Steps to land | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary 10 feet | 1 | 0 |
| Ordinary 20 feet | 1 | 1d6 |
| Ordinary 300 feet | 1 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 310 feet | 2 | 10d6 |
| Ordinary 610 feet | 3 | 10d6 |
| Feather Fall active through a 310-foot fall | 6 | 3d6 |
| 120 feet slowed, spell ends aloft, then 190 feet uncontrolled | 3 | 9d6 |

The 300-foot ordinary step, impact formulas, momentum reset, marker and duration conventions are provisional inventions. The source supplies Feather Fall's Action, five targets and 60-foot slowed descent. Wider hazards, equipment catches, flight loss and environmental damage still need the combat/campaign pass.
